prompt.composition: Widescreen oceanic cinematic tableau. Groups organized into underwater 'visual islands' across layered depths. Left: A Mosasaur duo (Global Mosasaurs, Pluridens) gliding gracefully. Center: An elegant long-necked Plesiosaur family (Elasmosaurids) arching their necks in an upright, curved loop. Right: A pair of ancient, smooth-shelled sea turtles (Araripemys) swimming downward in mid-stroke. Background: A massive, non-threatening filter-feeding marine vertebrate cruising peacefully in the upper sunlit open sea. Foreground: Schools of shimmering forage fish parting around pristine calcareous seabed nodules.
prompt.lighting: SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC. Intense, high-key midday sun filtering down through turquoise waters, creating beautiful, dancing refractive water ripples across the ocean floor plane and casting powerful golden rim-lighting on every marine creature silhouette to separate them from the deep sea depth.
prompt.texture_standard: High-end 3D character groom. Satiny-smooth skin, soft leathery flippers, and polished, high-gloss turtle shells. Zero grit, zero rough scales, zero scary predatory features, and completely rounded, friendly anatomy.

color_palette.mosasaurs: Saturated oceanic cyan and deep teal with decorative, cream-colored 'painted' belly patterns.
color_palette.plesiosaurs: Vibrant sunset-orange with soft white underbellies and deep purple counter-shading.
color_palette.sea_turtles: Polished olive-green shells with bright ivory edges and friendly glowing amber eyes.
color_palette.background_elements: Pure White and Golden Sand hues highlighting the pristine Tethys coastal margin aesthetics.

prompt.environment: Shallow, clear epicontinental seaway with floating strands of ancestral seagrass (Thalassotaenia) and drifting silver air bubbles. The seafloor consists of high-albedo chalky white sand mixed with large, smooth limestone nodules.
prompt.negative_prompt: photorealistic, grainy, lumpy skin, scales, grit, scary, horror, blood, open mouths, aggressive predatory behavior, sharp teeth, 90s CGI, plastic toy, grey water, muddy, dark abyssal sea, land dinosaurs, humans
